categories.main_business_segments: Taihan Textile Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: the yarn business division, which imports and sells cotton yarn, blended yarn, and high value-added specialty yarns and manages garment sewing sales; and the fabric business division, which dyes and processes fabrics to supply secondary textile manufacturers and sells dyed and processed fabrics and finished products directly to customers via online channels. Additionally, the company has a leasing segment generating rental income from commercial properties.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile manufacturing technologies including digital textile printing (DTP), dye sublimation printing (DSP), and NEXPRIT technology for fabric dyeing and processing. Production is centered at the Daegu plant, equipped with pre-treatment lines, multiple dyeing machines, flat and rotary printing machines, and digital printing equipment, supporting high-quality dyeing and finishing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taihan Textile serves a broad range of customers including large and small quilt, apparel, and bedding companies domestically and internationally. Its dyed and processed fabric products are sold to secondary textile manufacturers and end customers through online channels. The company also supplies garment products to brands like Costco and university teams in the U.S. The export market accounts for approximately 58.5% of sales, with domestic sales making up about 41.5%.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with its headquarters in Seoul and manufacturing facilities in Daegu. It also has overseas operations through its wholly owned subsidiary Taihan Textile (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., engaged in textile and other merchandise trading. The company’s export markets include the U.S. and Europe, among others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taihan Textile operates mainly in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on fabric dyeing, processing, and garment manufacturing. It imports raw yarns and fabrics, processes them, and supplies finished or semi-finished textile products to downstream manufacturers and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on developing differentiated and high value-added textile products while improving cost efficiency and quality stability. It invests in digital textile printing and smart factory initiatives, including digital twin technology, to transform into a digital smart factory. R&D efforts target military and workwear fabrics with specialized materials and camouflage patterns, aiming to enhance customer satisfaction and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Taihan Textile generates revenue primarily through product sales of yarns, fabrics, and garments both domestically and internationally. It also earns rental income from leasing commercial properties. Sales channels include direct sales to manufacturers, online retail to end customers, and export sales secured via letters of credit and other trade finance instruments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other listed textile firms such as Jeonbang, Ilshin Textile, and Dongil Textile in the Korean textile industry. While it has a significant export presence, its sales have declined recently due to challenging global economic conditions. Taihan positions itself as a producer of high-quality dyed and processed fabrics with a focus on innovation and digital transformation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Taihan Textile reported consolidated sales of approximately 149.4 billion KRW, a 22% decrease from the previous year, and an operating loss of about 1.8 billion KRW, continuing a trend of operating deficits. Total assets stood at around 180.7 billion KRW, with a debt-to-equity ratio of 38%. The company has been reducing debt and investing in smart factory upgrades to improve future performance.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taihan Textile emphasizes high-quality, high value-added textile products with advanced dyeing and finishing technologies. Its value proposition includes customized fabric processing, digital printing capabilities, and development of specialized military and workwear textiles. The company aims to lead the rapidly changing textile market by adopting digital smart factory solutions and focusing on customer satisfaction through innovation and quality.
